offline.title: We couldn't reach the server
offline.body: Check that Wi-Fi or mobile data is on, then try again.

timeout.title: This is taking longer than usual
timeout.body: Your connection may be unstable, or the server is busy. Try again in a moment.

server.title: Something broke on our side
server.body: This isn't your fault. We're on it — try again in a moment.

rateLimited.title: A lot of requests are coming in
rateLimited.body: Waiting about a minute usually clears it up.

sessionExpired.title: Please sign in again
sessionExpired.body: Your session expired for security. Signing in takes you right back to where you were.

forbidden.title: This account can't open that screen
forbidden.body: Check that you're signed in to the right account. Contact us if it keeps happening.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that
notFound.body: It may have been deleted or moved. Go back and open it again.

conflict.title: This may already be updated
conflict.body: Refresh the screen to see the current state.

badRequest.title: Check what you entered
badRequest.body: Something is missing or in the wrong format.

unknown.title: We couldn't finish that
unknown.body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact us and we'll look into it.

COMMON_ERROR_001.title: Check what you entered
COMMON_ERROR_001.body: Something is missing or in the wrong format.

COMMON_ERROR_002.title: Please sign in again
COMMON_ERROR_002.body: Your session expired. Signing in lets you pick up where you left off.

COMMON_ERROR_003.title: This account can't open that screen
COMMON_ERROR_003.body: Check that you're signed in to the right account. Contact us if it keeps happening.

COMMON_ERROR_004.title: We couldn't find that
COMMON_ERROR_004.body: It may have been deleted or moved. Go back and open it again.

COMMON_ERROR_005.title: Something broke on our side
COMMON_ERROR_005.body: This isn't your fault. Try again in a moment.

TOKEN_ERROR_001.title: Please sign in again
TOKEN_ERROR_001.body: We couldn't confirm your session. Signing in lets you pick up where you left off.

TOKEN_ERROR_002.title: Please sign in again
TOKEN_ERROR_002.body: Your session is no longer valid. Signing in lets you pick up where you left off.

TOKEN_ERROR_003.title: Please sign in again
TOKEN_ERROR_003.body: Your session expired for security. Signing in takes you right back to where you were.

TOKEN_ERROR_004.title: Please sign in again
TOKEN_ERROR_004.body: You were signed out automatically after a long time away.

TOKEN_ERROR_005.title: Your signup session expired
TOKEN_ERROR_005.body: Verify your email again and you can continue signing up.

TOKEN_ERROR_006.title: Your password reset expired
TOKEN_ERROR_006.body: Request a new verification code and start again.

LOGIN_ERROR_001.title: That email or password doesn't match
LOGIN_ERROR_001.body: Check for typos and capital letters. You can reset your password if you don't remember it.

SIGNUP_ERROR_001.title: This email already has an account
SIGNUP_ERROR_001.body: You can sign in with it right now. Reset your password if you don't remember it.

SIGNUP_ERROR_002.title: Check your date of birth
SIGNUP_ERROR_002.body: Make sure it's a real date and not in the future.

SIGNUP_ERROR_003.title: That nickname is taken
SIGNUP_ERROR_003.body: Add a number to the end, or try another nickname.

SIGNUP_ERROR_004.title: You already have an account
SIGNUP_ERROR_004.body: Sign in and you can start using it right away.

MAIL_ERROR_001.title: We can't send a code to this address
MAIL_ERROR_001.body: Check the address for typos. A personal email usually works when a work or school one doesn't.

MAIL_ERROR_002.title: The verification email didn't go out
MAIL_ERROR_002.body: Request it again in a moment. If it keeps failing, try a different email address.

OTP_ERROR_001.title: We already sent a code
OTP_ERROR_001.body: Check your inbox and spam folder. You can request a new code in 30 seconds.

OTP_ERROR_002.title: That code expired
OTP_ERROR_002.body: Request a new code and enter it again.

OTP_ERROR_003.title: That code doesn't match
OTP_ERROR_003.body: Check the 6 digits in the email. If you asked for several, the newest one works.

AUTH_ERROR_001.title: No account uses this email
AUTH_ERROR_001.body: Check the address. If you haven't signed up yet, you can create an account with it.

AUTH_ERROR_002.title: Social sign-in didn't finish
AUTH_ERROR_002.body: Tap it once more. You can also sign in with email if it keeps failing.

AUTH_ERROR_003.title: That sign-in method isn't supported yet
AUTH_ERROR_003.body: Use Google, Apple, Kakao, or email instead.

AUTH_ERROR_004.title: We didn't get an email from that account
AUTH_ERROR_004.body: Allow email sharing when you sign in. You can also sign up with email directly.

AUTH_ERROR_005.title: Finish your profile to use this
AUTH_ERROR_005.body: It takes about a minute. You can continue right now.

AUTH_ERROR_006.title: This account was deleted
AUTH_ERROR_006.body: Sign up again with the same email to come back. Past records can't be restored.

AUTH_ERROR_007.title: This account is suspended
AUTH_ERROR_007.body: Contact us and we'll explain the reason and how to restore it.

AUTH_ERROR_008.title: This account is being deleted
AUTH_ERROR_008.body: Cancel the deletion and you can sign in with it again.

AUTH_ERROR_009.title: This email is registered through social sign-in
AUTH_ERROR_009.body: Sign in with that social account, or verify your identity to connect email sign-in.

AUTH_ERROR_010.title: There's nothing more to fill in
AUTH_ERROR_010.body: Your profile is already complete. Head home to keep going.

AUTH_ERROR_011.title: Accept the terms to finish signing up
AUTH_ERROR_011.body: Review the required terms and agree to them.

AUTH_ERROR_012.title: Your signup session expired
AUTH_ERROR_012.body: Start again from the sign-in screen and you can continue.

CHAT_ERROR_001.title: This conversation is gone
CHAT_ERROR_001.body: It may have been deleted here or on another device. Pick one from the list.

CHAT_ERROR_002.title: This account can't open that conversation
CHAT_ERROR_002.body: Sign in with the account that created this conversation.

CHAT_ERROR_004.title: Write something to send
CHAT_ERROR_004.body: One character is enough to send a message.

ONBOARDING_ERROR_001.title: Some answers are still missing
ONBOARDING_ERROR_001.body: Fill in the marked items and you can move on.

ONBOARDING_ERROR_002.title: Check the value you picked
ONBOARDING_ERROR_002.body: Choose one of the options in the list.

WITHDRAW_ERROR_001.title: Deletion is already requested
WITHDRAW_ERROR_001.body: To cancel it, continue from the sign-in screen.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_001.title: This post is gone
COMMUNITY_ERROR_001.body: The author may have deleted it. Refresh the list to see current posts.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_002.title: You can only change your own posts
COMMUNITY_ERROR_002.body: If you wrote it on another account, sign in with that one.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_003.title: You already reported this post
COMMUNITY_ERROR_003.body: We're reviewing it. There's no need to report it again.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_004.title: This poll is gone
COMMUNITY_ERROR_004.body: The author may have deleted it. Refresh the list.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_005.title: You already voted in this poll

COMMUNITY_ERROR_006.title: That option isn't there anymore
COMMUNITY_ERROR_006.body: The poll may have been edited. Refresh and choose again.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_007.title: This poll takes one choice
COMMUNITY_ERROR_007.body: Narrow it down to one and you can vote.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_008.title: This comment is gone
COMMUNITY_ERROR_008.body: The author may have deleted it. Refresh to see current comments.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_009.title: You can only change your own comments
COMMUNITY_ERROR_009.body: If you wrote it on another account, sign in with that one.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_010.title: The comment you're replying to is gone
COMMUNITY_ERROR_010.body: Refresh and write your reply again.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_011.title: You already reported this comment
COMMUNITY_ERROR_011.body: We're reviewing it. There's no need to report it again.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_012.title: This story is gone
COMMUNITY_ERROR_012.body: Stories disappear automatically 24 hours after they're posted.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_013.title: You can only delete your own stories
COMMUNITY_ERROR_013.body: If you posted it on another account, sign in with that one.

COMMUNITY_ERROR_014.title: Pick one photo
COMMUNITY_ERROR_014.body: A story needs a photo before you can post it.

FOOD_CAMERA_001.title: Use a JPG or PNG photo
FOOD_CAMERA_001.body: For other formats, edit and save the photo in your gallery to convert it to JPG.

FOOD_CAMERA_002.title: That photo is over 5 MB
FOOD_CAMERA_002.body: Pick another photo, or shrink it in your editor before uploading.

FOOD_CAMERA_003.title: We couldn't find food in this photo
FOOD_CAMERA_003.body: Retake it in good light with the food filling the frame. You can also type it in instead.

FOOD_CAMERA_004.title: The analysis is taking a while
FOOD_CAMERA_004.body: Try again in a moment. Large photos take longer.

FOOD_CAMERA_005.title: We couldn't analyze this meal
FOOD_CAMERA_005.body: Try again in a moment. You can also type it in to record it.

FOOD_CAMERA_006.title: The photo didn't upload
FOOD_CAMERA_006.body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, use a different photo.

FOOD_CAMERA_007.title: This analysis is gone
FOOD_CAMERA_007.body: It may have been deleted from your records. Pick one from the list.

FOOD_CAMERA_008.title: The photo didn't load
FOOD_CAMERA_008.body: Open it again in a moment.

FOOD_CAMERA_009.title: Tell us a bit more about the meal
FOOD_CAMERA_009.body: Something like "a bowl of brown rice, miso soup" — names and amounts are enough to analyze.

FOOD_CAMERA_010.title: A lot of analyses are running
FOOD_CAMERA_010.body: Waiting about a minute usually clears it up.

FOOD_CAMERA_011.title: The start date is after the end date
FOOD_CAMERA_011.body: Pick a start date that comes before the end date.

FOOD_CAMERA_013.title: This meal record is gone
FOOD_CAMERA_013.body: It may have been deleted. Refresh the list to see current records.

FOOD_CAMERA_015.title: Name this meal
FOOD_CAMERA_015.body: One character is enough to save it.

HC_ERROR_001.title: Pick a different verification method
HC_ERROR_001.body: Choose one of the methods shown on screen.

HC_ERROR_002.title: Your verification expired
HC_ERROR_002.body: Verify again from the start to load your screening results.

HC_ERROR_003.title: No confirmation came from the auth app
HC_ERROR_003.body: Open the auth app, approve the request, then try again.

HC_ERROR_004.title: We couldn't find this screening result

HC_ERROR_005.title: The provider didn't return your results
HC_ERROR_005.body: Records can be unavailable during the health service's maintenance window. Try again in a moment.

HC_ERROR_006.title: Pick the results to analyze
HC_ERROR_006.body: Choose at least one and you can run the analysis.

HC_ERROR_007.title: We couldn't read your screening results
HC_ERROR_007.body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact us and we'll look into it.

DOCTOR_ERROR_001.title: Enter a name, hospital, or department
DOCTOR_ERROR_001.body: Any one of them is enough to search.

DOCTOR_ERROR_002.title: No doctor matched that search
DOCTOR_ERROR_002.body: Try part of the name or the hospital name instead.

DOCTOR_ERROR_003.title: That connection is gone
DOCTOR_ERROR_003.body: It may have been disconnected. Refresh the list.

DOCTOR_ERROR_004.title: Sharing opens once the connection is approved
DOCTOR_ERROR_004.body: We'll let you know when your doctor accepts.

SOCIAL_CONFIG_ERROR.title: Social sign-in isn’t available in this version
SOCIAL_CONFIG_ERROR.body: This is an app configuration issue, not your connection. Please use email sign-in and let us know so we can fix it.

BILLING_ERROR_001.title: This one is part of Premium
BILLING_ERROR_001.body: Subscribe and you can use it right away.

BILLING_ERROR_002.title: You've used all your free tries
BILLING_ERROR_002.body: They open up again next period. Premium removes the limit.

BILLING_ERROR_003.title: We couldn't check your subscription
BILLING_ERROR_003.body: Try again in a moment. If you've already paid, nothing is lost.
